scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev --workspace=server" "npm run dev --workspace=client"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=server && npm run build --workspace=client
scripts.db:migrate: dotenv -e server/.env -- prisma migrate dev --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.db:deploy: dotenv -e server/.env -- prisma migrate deploy --schema prisma/schema.prisma
